page: Command-line flags for create-hono project initializer (npm create hono@latest, npx, pnpm, bun, deno variants). Arguments passed after -- for npm/npx. Commonly used flags: --template <template>, --install, --pm <packageManager>, --offline. Template examples: bun, cloudflare-workers, vercel, deno. Package managers: npm, pnpm, yarn. Offline mode uses local cache without network. Interactive and non-interactive flows. Minimal example: npm create hono@latest my-app. Advanced: npm create hono@latest my-app -- --template vercel --pm npm --install. Offline: pnpm create hono@latest my-app --template deno --offline. Tips: ensure -- is used with npm; check create-hono repository for full flag list. Questions: How do I skip template prompts? Which templates are available? How do I specify a package manager? How do I use offline mode? What's the syntax for npm create?

sections.manifest: Argument forwarding syntax differs by package manager. npm: requires -- before flags; example: npm create hono@latest my-app -- --template cloudflare-workers. yarn: no -- needed; --template cloudflare-workers. pnpm: no -- needed; --template cloudflare-workers. bun: no -- needed; --template cloudflare-workers. deno: deno init --npm hono@latest my-app --template cloudflare-workers. Important: npm/npx require -- to forward arguments to initializer. Questions: Why does npm need --? What's the difference between npm and other managers? How do I forward flags correctly?

Common command-line arguments. --template <template>: select starter template, skip interactive prompt. Examples: bun, cloudflare-workers, vercel, etc. --install: automatically install dependencies after creation. --pm <packageManager>: specify package manager (npm, pnpm, yarn). --offline: use local cache instead of fetching remote templates, for offline/deterministic runs. Table format with examples. Note: full template list and options maintained by create-hono project; see repository for authoritative reference. Questions: What does --template do? How do I auto-install? Which package managers are supported? When do I use --offline?

Three example workflows. Minimal interactive: npm create hono@latest my-app prompts for template and options. Non-interactive: npm create hono@latest my-app -- --template vercel --pm npm --install creates with vercel template, npm dependencies, skips prompts. Offline: pnpm create hono@latest my-app --template deno --offline uses local cache without network. Questions: How do I set up interactively? What's the fully automated flow? How do I work offline?
